caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a long, hooded cloak. The cloak is brown with a subtle texture, extending from the shoulders down to the ground in wide, closed folds. It features a large hood, which is deep and lined with a darker shade of brown or reddish-brown fabric on the inside. The cloak is fastened at the neck with a dark green or olive ribbon tied in a bow, which also extends down the front. The shoulders are covered with a short capelet, which is part of the same fabric as the main body of the cloak. The background is plain and light-colored, with a slight gradient that suggests a neutral, off-white surface, and there are no additional objects or patterns in the composition.
title: Shaker Woman's Cloak
